objective: Implement all six generalized follow-ups, measure matched gains and regressions, and publish beneficial validated implementations to each affected main repository.

requirements.deliverable: Ordinary source -> existing checked general fold law -> efficient lowering; no authored embedding layout required. Test immutable per-lane captures and negative varying-input cases.
General prepared typed GPU boundaries with fresh checks for changed inputs. Isolate conversion, upload count, read/decode and setup contributions using matched controls.
Reusable exact access-oriented layout alternatives, preserving bits, indexing/defaults and migration costs. Selection requires compatible lifecycle evidence.
General bounded cooperative map/ordered-reduction/map GPU lowering, preserving operation order and resource fallback. Compare fused and unfused on unrelated workloads.
Compose observable pure consumers on resident GPU values using general runtime/placement machinery, while retaining required public outputs and lifetime checks.
General interval/error-bound top-k certification and strict refinement of ambiguous candidates. Error bounds must be certified, not inferred from measured maximum errors.

measurement_contract.correctness: Independent ordered F32 reference; ordinary and prepared calls; complete detached output consumption. Native approximate work must have an explicit contract and strict final ranking certification.
measurement_contract.profitability: Separate correctness, applicability and profitability. Retain setup/conversion/migration, complete-call samples, adverse results and host/device identities. Never add separately timed phase medians as an overlapped total.
measurement_contract.publication: Publish only beneficial validated implementation changes; retain rejected experimental candidates and negative results. All changed independent packages and distribution pins/locks must agree, with required checks green.
